_comment: The home page's curated shelf. Two groups, twelve entries, and every one of them is checked against the dataset at build time by `deriveShelves` in `lib/landing.ts`: an id that is not in the catalog, an entry LiteSPM cannot install, an entry whose source is not the one declared here, or an entry that depends on a host whose vendor has ended, fails the build. Nothing here may be invented - the id is the catalog's own id, and the use-case line is editorial prose that must not contradict the row's own summary. Each group is one provenance, so the line a reader is shown about where a row came from is true of every row in it.
